column1: # Canonical paths for VC6 anonymous namespace scopes (?%<path><hash>@).
# VC6 embeds the absolute source-file path + CRC32 hash into the mangled
# names of anonymous-namespace COMDATs.  That path is machine-specific,
# so the normalization step replaces it with the retail RTTI-proven
# Evidence: retail RTTI type descriptor at 0x6778c0
# unit: owning compiland; the alias never applies in other units.
# source_basename: case-insensitive filename that appears before the hash
# in our compiled anonymous namespace scope.
# canonical_scope: the <path><hash> body between ?% and @, preserved in RTTI.
